source_of_attestation: explicit repository-owner confirmation in project conversation
scope: all datasets and document collections mapped in the RONIN-IA dataset inventory as of 2026-11-05, including NASA NTRS candidate packs and the mapped ScienceVerse and PMC OA acquisitions
interpretation: Human review coverage is attested by the repository owner. This record does not fabricate per-document reviewer identities, review notes, signatures, or hashes.
admission_limits: Only documents with exact payload hashes and traceable source provenance can be considered for admission.
Exact and near-duplicate checks must still be run globally across all candidate sources and existing admitted corpora.
Quality, privacy, source-specific restrictions, and split-isolation validators must pass on the exact candidate payloads.
Metadata-only rights records are never treated as text-training permission.
Validation, test, benchmark, tutor, synthetic, and quarantined specialist partitions remain excluded from training.
Human review attestation does not automatically set training_eligible or global_g0_pass.
